evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that this model is among the strongest open-weight models, with a composite score of 45.05%.
evaluation.safety_evals: The developer states that the model does not have any moderation mechanism.

identity.name: Chocolatine-2-14B-Instruct-v2.0.3
identity.summary: A DPO fine-tune of a merged Qwen-2.5-14B model, trained on a French RLHF dataset.

links.citation: The developer asks users to cite the model as made with love in France.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: The card reports a composite score of 45.05% and no moderation mechanism for an open-weight instruct LLM, so it can plausibly produce factually inaccurate or ungrounded text.

possible_risks.description: In AI-assisted decision-making tasks, reliance measures how much a person trusts (and potentially acts on) a model's output. Over-reliance occurs when a person puts too much trust in a model, accepting a model's output when the model's output is likely incorrect. Under-reliance is the opposite, where the person doesn't trust the model but should.
possible_risks.justification: The card reports only a composite score of 45.05% and no safety/moderation evaluation, so users of this open-weight instruct model have little basis for calibrated trust and may over-rely on its outputs.

possible_risks.description: A metric selected to measure or track a risk is incorrectly selected, incompletely measuring the risk, or measuring the wrong risk for the given context.
possible_risks.justification: The card reports a single composite score of 45.05% and states the model has no moderation mechanism, so any claimed safety/performance evaluation is incomplete for measuring risks like harmful or biased outputs.

possible_risks.description: Manipulative prompts that use social engineering techniques, such as role-playing or hypothetical scenarios, to persuade the model into generating harmful content.
possible_risks.justification: The card states the model is an open-weight instruct LLM with no moderation mechanism, making it more plausible that manipulative role-play or hypothetical-scenario prompts could elicit harmful content.

specifications.model_size: 27.5 GiB of safetensors weights (29,531,961,856 bytes) in F16

training_context.adaptations: The model was adapted through DPO fine-tuning on the jpacifico/french-orca-dpo-pairs-revised RLHF dataset.
training_context.training_data: The model is a DPO fine-tune of the merged checkpoint jpacifico/Chocolatine-2-merged-qwen25arch, which uses a Qwen-2.5-14B architecture, trained on the jpacifico/french-orca-dpo-pairs-revised RLHF dataset.
